name: Tiingo development risk-filter pilot
hypothesis: A binary filter that defaults to the blend can improve risk-adjusted results without excessive missed exposure.
decision_gate: Advance only if all three TMU seeds beat the blend and simple risk filter in standard zero-risk-free Sharpe at every cost, with no worse maximum drawdown than the blend.
selection_policy: Report every seed. Do not select the best seed. These are development data already used in earlier research.
limitations: Pilot capacity (200 clauses, 10 epochs) chosen before execution; current-vintage data; zero cash yield; daily target rebalancing; adjusted-close execution proxy. Cost scenarios replay the same predictions without retraining. No holdout access.
